function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The question is purely descriptive: 'Which penguin species has the highest mean flipper length?' It does not ask for a causal or controlled comparison. The answer is simply the species with the highest observed mean flipper length across all penguins in the dataset. Even though species and island are perfectly confounded, we are not estimating a causal effect, so the confounding does not invalidate the descriptive summary. We can compute the overall mean flipper length per species by aggregating across all rows, regardless of island, because the question does not require adjustment for confounding. The confounding affects inference about causality, not the description of observed data."}
